$comment: Canonical public service catalog for clinovian.com. Machine-readable mirror of the published prices and turnarounds on each service page. Verified against those pages by scripts/validate_site.py on every release — update this file and the page together.

services.name: Medical Necessity Escalation Memo
services.scope: Physician-authored criteria and record analysis for a client appeal workflow; not a final legal/procedural submission.

services.name: Observation vs. Inpatient Defense Memo
services.scope: Plan-specific level-of-care analysis with exact timestamps and applicability checks.

services.name: DRG Downgrade Clinical Validation Memo
services.scope: Clinical validation support for credentialed CDI/coding review; no independent code assignment.

services.name: Post-Acute Denial Escalation Memo
services.scope: Setting- and plan-specific analysis for SNF, IRF, LTACH or home health; each framework is assessed separately.

services.name: Peer-to-Peer Preparation Brief
services.scope: Call-preparation brief for the treating/client clinician; Clinovian does not impersonate or replace the treating clinician.

services.name: Pre-Denial Medical Necessity Dossier
services.scope: Pre-submission evidence-gap analysis designed to improve completeness, not promise approval.

services.name: AI Appeal Clinical QA
services.scope: Claim-to-source physician QA of AI-drafted clinical reasoning; model, input and release controls are defined in scope.

services.name: Federal IDR Clinical Value Dossier
services.turnaround: 3–5 business days after complete agreed record
services.scope: Clinical evidence organization only; client or authorized representative owns eligibility, deadlines, filing, legal analysis and offer selection.

services.name: No-PHI Clinical Denial AR Triage
services.scope: Inventory prioritization, not case merits, deadline verification or recovery forecasting.
